external_boundaries.purpose: Check whether a newer published Vera version is available
external_boundaries.content: An HTTP GET with ordinary connection metadata and a generic update-check User-Agent. No client, case, prompt, plugin version, or locally stored file content is placed in the URL or request body.
external_boundaries.retention: When Codex supplies a plugin-data directory, Vera stores the downloaded public manifest and check time locally and reuses them for up to 24 hours. Without that directory, Vera makes a new check on first use in each conversation. Mparanza controls its hosted access-log retention.
controls: The Vera skill invokes the installed checker on first use in a Codex conversation with local tools. The checker starts from one fixed HTTPS manifest URL and uses a three-second timeout.
The request has no query string or request body and is not built from case or conversation content.
The version-only invocation returns package identity and any update notice without polling feedback. No tutorial, profile, lesson, installed version or local path is sent.
